svg.title: Unlimited over six channels
svg.desc: Spectrograms of one hf transmission after clean, USB shifted, LSB, AM, FM and CCIR poor channels, each with the real decoder's result.
svg.text: One hf transmission through six simulated channels
“CQ DE PY2” (9 bytes, hf preset) through sim::Channel; spectrograms 300–2700 Hz of the received audio (2.1 s each);
every tile is decoded by the real Decoder with the profile shown; the result is what it released.
grid below f_ref, SNR est. 80.2 dB
grid below f_ref, SNR est. 9.9 dB
grid above f_ref, SNR est. 10.3 dB
grid below f_ref, SNR est. 4.6 dB
grid below f_ref, SNR est. 21.0 dB
grid below f_ref, SNR est. 14.3 dB
SNR: key-down tone power over noise in 2500 Hz (AM: carrier power; FM: CNR in 12.5 kHz). The receiver sets only its profile;
f_ref, T, k, N and the grid side come from the tune tone, the markers and the 8-slot header.
